verdict.rationale: HumanLayer has some programmatic surface: `humanlayer automation run` runs Cloud-visible sessions from CI, cron or scripts, launch tokens support non-interactive remote daemon bootstrap, and workspace behavior is driven by JSON config files. There is no evidence of a documented API that matches the UI, and probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404 on every candidate path. Many documented capabilities are described only as UI actions, including comments and review, draft PR creation from the GitHub tab, metrics, and the task composer. Missing for 10: a documented public API, an API reference or OpenAPI spec, programmatic equivalents for UI features (task creation, review and comments, metrics, integrations setup), and evidence of UI/API parity.
